name: Ayesha

appearance.hair: charcoal low bun with grey strands
appearance.detail: calm eyes and a measured half-smile

personality: Patient, observant and methodical. Notices small problems before they become emergencies.
signature: Cuff inspection: checks her wrist seal, then gives one quiet nod.

name: Maya

appearance.detail: direct eyes and firm relaxed mouth

personality: Composed, decisive and economical with gestures. Reassures others through a steady presence.
signature: Team check: a small open-palm acknowledgement followed by a settled stance.

name: Bilal

appearance.detail: clean shaven, compact earpiece and eager expression

personality: Curious and diligent, with a little nervous energy. Double-checks a signal before speaking.
signature: Headset adjustment: listens, checks a small readout and settles his shoulders.

name: Lin
personality: Precise, attentive and unflustered. Gives clear directions and waits for acknowledgement.
signature: Readback: touches the headset, pauses to listen, then gives a concise confirmation.

name: Dr. Sana

appearance.detail: round glasses and curious attentive eyes

personality: Reflective and inquisitive. Pauses to compare evidence before deciding what it means.
signature: Observation: adjusts her glasses, tilts her head and notes one detail.

name: Kofi

appearance.detail: short neat beard and warm small smile

personality: Hands-on, calm and encouraging. Handles equipment carefully and is quick to share a useful finding.
signature: Sample check: raises a labelled-by-code sample container for inspection, then lowers it safely.

name: Omar

appearance.hair: grey temples and short grey beard
appearance.detail: cautious kind eyes and a measured expression

personality: Grounded and conscientious. Prefers one deliberate check to a hurried assumption.
signature: Checklist: follows the entries with a finger, then checks the next item.

name: Zara

appearance.detail: alert eyes and confident small smile

personality: Energetic, inclusive and focused. Connects a plan to the next concrete action.
signature: Briefing: checks the plan, indicates the next station and gives a confident nod.
